Are you ready for a hands-on technical role where every day brings new challenges, growth opportunities, and the chance to work with cutting-edge CNC technology? Join a leading international production company and be part of a team that shapes aluminum components for clients worldwide. Wie zoeken we? Technical insight or experience in a manufacturing or production environment Willingness to work in a 3-shift system Access to your own transportation (site is not easily accessible by public transport) Fluency in Dutch, English or German A curious, precise, and growth-minded attitude Wat bieden wij je? €20.18 gross per hour including allowances (see below how it is calculated) Full-time job of 37,5 hours per week in 3 shifts Travel reimbursement Comprehensive onboarding and personal coaching Possibility of a permanent contract after proven performance Opportunities for training and professional growth Friendly, professional, and international team environment How is the salary calculated? The basic hourly wage is €16.06. You will receive a 120% bonus for all hours worked, whether you work early, late, or night shifts. €16.06 x 120% = €19.27. On top of that, you will also receive €0.91 in ADV per hour worked: €19.27 + €0.91 = €20.18 gross per hour. Functieomschrijving As a CNC Operator, you are at the heart of our production process, ensuring every part meets the highest standards. You will: Set up, calibrate, and operate advanced CNC machines Transform raw aluminum into precise, high-quality components following technical drawings Conduct thorough quality checks using calipers, micrometers, and other measuring tools Finish parts with sanding, grinding, and cleaning Assemble and package final products ready for shipment No experience? No worries, we’ll get you fully up to speed with an intensive two-week training program! Ready to Take the Next Step? Apply today via the button on this page!
